title: Vehicle Repairs Administrator
description:
Vehicle Repairs Administrator

Location : Tipton

Hours : Monday - Friday (Apply online only)

Salary £26500

Vehicle Sales Administrator

To manage the administration and coordination of bodywork repair activity, ensuring quality, cost control, and timely vehicle return to service.

Key Responsibilities

Coordinate bodywork repair jobs from intake to completion

Liaise with bodyshops, insurers, and suppliers to progress repairs

Manage estimates, approvals, and invoicing in line with agreed processes

title: Sales Administrator
description:
Sales Administrator

Salary: 25,000 - 28,000

Location: Walsall

Job Type: Permanent

We're looking for a highly organised and proactive Sales Administrator, to join our team. You'll play a key role in ensuring customer orders move smoothly from initial processing through to production, delivery, and installation. Working closely with the Operations Director, sales team, suppliers, and internal departments, you'll help keep operations running efficiently while contributing to ongoing process improvements.

The Role

As the central point of coordination for sales operations, you'll ensure orders are processed accurately, delivery schedules stay on track, and communication between teams remains seamless.

Key Responsibilities
- Process customer orders within the CRM system, checking product details before releasing them to production.
- Coordinate amendments to non-standard orders, ensuring production teams are fully informed of any changes.
- Liaise with customers to arrange or amend delivery and installation dates.
- Work closely with suppliers to ensure components arrive on schedule.
- Monitor installation-day readiness, highlighting shortages or issues to the engineering team.
- Raise purchase orders and prepare customer invoices.
- Maintain accurate order documentation, including delivery notes and completion records.
- Provide the sales team with weekly updates on order progress and completion times.
- Support the wider sales function with administrative tasks, including preparing and updating quotations, specifications, and supporting documents.

What We're Looking For
- Around 1-2 years' experience in sales support, administration, or customer service, although motivated graduates with the right attitude will also be considered.
- Experience using CRM or ERP systems would be an advantage.
- Strong IT skills, particularly across Microsoft Office.
- Excellent communication skills with a confident and professional telephone manner.
- The ability to stay organised while managing multiple tasks and changing priorities.
- GCSEs (or equivalent) in Maths and English.
- A collaborative approach and confidence communicating with colleagues across all levels of the business.
- A positive, self-assured attitude with the ability to handle a variety of situations effectively.

What's On Offer
- 25,000 - 28,000 salary
- 25 days' holiday, including the Christmas shutdown
- 37.5-hour working week, Monday to Friday
- Company pension scheme
- A friendly, supportive office environment with opportunities to contribute to improving business processes.

title: Administrator
description:
Administrator Tipton
£12.71+ per hour
Monday to Friday, 9:00am - 5:00pm
Temporary Assignment
Immediate Start Available
Safer Hand Solutions are currently recruiting for an experienced Administrator to join a busy care home environment in Tipton on a temporary basis.
This is a fantastic opportunity for a highly organised individual who can provide vital administrative support to the Home Manager and wider team.
Key Responsibilities:
- Answering telephone calls, emails and reception enquiries
- Managing filing systems and maintaining accurate records
- Taking minutes at meetings and supporting diary management
- Processing purchase orders, invoices and supplier queries
- Supporting petty cash and resident monies administration
- Assisting with payroll administration, timesheets and agency records
- Supporting recruitment administration and personnel file maintenance
- Maintaining compliance records and ensuring documentation is up to date
- Providing general administrative support to the Home Manager and wider team

Requirements:
- Previous administration experience is essential
- Strong IT and Microsoft Office skills
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail
- Experience handling confidential information
- Ability to work independently and prioritise workload
- Experience within a care home, healthcare or social care setting would be advantageous
- An enhanced DBS check will be required for this role

What's On Offer:
- Immediate start
- Weekly pay
- Full-time hours
- Supportive working environment
- Potential extension beyond the initial assignment

If you are available immediately and have the skills and experience required, we'd love to hear from you.
